caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned vertically in the center of the page, primarily rendered in brown, black, and dark tones. The main object is a dome-shaped structure with a smooth, brown surface, mounted on a tripod-like base composed of three curved, black legs. There is a circular, black component at the center of the dome’s front face, featuring a smaller circle with a few bolts around the edge. At the top of the dome, a rectangular plate with two bolts is attached. Below the main drawing, at the lower left, there is a smaller inset sketch in pencil showing the same object at a three-quarter angle with various construction lines and a visible side support or handle. The object appears to be labeled with the height “1’ 2” (1 foot, 2 inches). The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Bellows
